text: The collections module offers specialized containers that solve common problems elegantly.
Counter tallies how often each item appears, in a single line.
Ask for the two most common letters in mississippi, and it instantly reports i and s, four each.
[chuckle] defaultdict is a dictionary that supplies a default value for any missing key automatically.
Here it defaults to an empty list, so we can group words by their first letter without checking if the key exists.
[sniff] No more clumsy if-key-not-in-dict boilerplate — the default just appears when needed.
namedtuple gives you a lightweight record with named fields, far more readable than a plain tuple.
[sigh] Now you access p dot x and p dot y by name, while it still behaves like a tuple underneath.
[groan] Counter, defaultdict, and namedtuple replace piles of manual code — they're everyday power tools.
